questions.question: Discuss the significance of using CSS for Web development.
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the significance of using CSS for Web Development. /
  • CSS is essential because:
  • • Separates content and design for cleaner structure.
  • • Enables consistent styling across multiple web pages.
  • • Allows responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • • Supports advanced layouts like Flexbox and Grid.
  • • Reduces repeated code and speeds up development.
  • • Enhances appearance with animations, effects, colors, and typography.
  • • Improves user experience by creating visually appealing and readable pages.
